data.description:
Ferreti Destiny 85 ft is the perfect yacht for a boat day out with the family. Holds up to 13 guests on board with more than enough room to walk around not having to bump into any of your group members. This boat comes with a captain included for your worry free day.

Your boat comes equipped with boundless amenities including; Bluetooth stereo system to play your favorite jams. Also take advantage of our a giant water mat.
data.highlights:

data.itinerary:
###TYPICAL ITINERARY RECOMMEND FOR DIFFERENT DURATION TRIPS:

**2 Hours Trip**
- Tour Brickell/ Biscayne bay and marine stadium/ Hobie beach and have good water time.
- Sunset tours beautiful too through Miami river Brickell with skyline. Fisher island the best spot in Miami for sunset. Don't tell anybody🤣🫶.
- Tour millionaire homes / star island and venetian islands area. Quick stop on monument island for quick swim if left marina punctually. (Picnic island also an option)

**3 Hours Trip**
-  More real water swim time for everyone! (We can organize a jet ski to come to the boat too)
- Added to millionaire homes we can go to sunset islands which is beautiful and much more relaxed and exclusive.
- Again marine stadium/ Hobie beach for more water time.

Our recommendation is Vizcaya sandbar. There are other sandbars (bear cut/Nixon) which we can go but to have a great time on the water (that's why you go to a sandbar) you need a bit more time. 

####FYI: There are no bars at the Sandbar

**4 Hours Trip – the most complete and popular 💪**

- You can do most of the above together and in any order with more flexibility, and enjoy your time on the water without looking constantly at your watch. With 4 hours you have time to stay longer in one spot if you're having a good time.

All destinations above are available and also take time to properly enjoy Bear Cut and Nixon sandbar. No Name Harbor, Vizcaya Museum, and Key Biscayne area are options also.

**6 Hours Trip**
- VIP section and some exclusive locations no one will take you

- Weather tide allowing: Stittsville and Fowey rocks. Super local vibe. Stittsville are some wooden houses built over the shallow waters past Key Biscayne in the early 1930s in the “prohibition” era where all the gambling etc. took place. Very cool and interesting. Google it.

Fowey rocks lighthouse. A lighthouse in the middle of nowhere with the most crystal waters around. Its BEAUTIFUL. Google it too. Weather allowing.

Haulover sandbar also recommended from 6 hours

**FOR ALL: Fisher Island is BEAUTIFUL for sunset.**

data.booking_notes:
##85 ft Ferreti Destiny

###Address: 
*3399 NW South River Dr
Miami, FL  33142
United States*

###Activities Coordinator: **MIKE**
(786) 670-3013

##Confirmation:
###85 ft Ferreti Destiny

Here is some info that I hope will answer any questions you may have. 

Please try and arrive a half hour early as we have sign coast guard documents and get you guys comfortable on the yacht. Safety first.

The crew and yacht will be ready for you for the start of your contracted time. The yacht runs on a tight schedule and adjusting start times is not an option. Please try and arrive early. 

The captain will address all of your guests about safety first. It’s real important that everyone is paying attention. We take the safety of our guests very seriously. 

Federal Law limits the maximum amount of guests allowed on a Recreational Bareboat Charter is 13. Kids count towards the total of 13. The captain and crew DO NOT count. Please make sure we don’t have more than 13 as there are no exceptions. 

Everyone must remove their shoes while onboard the yacht. 

Some smoking is permitted on the yacht. Cigarettes, Cigars, Wacky tabaky is ok as long as the guests are using a small cup for the ashes. Hookahs are NOT allowed on the yacht (no exceptions). Vapes are okay. 

Use of the bathroom is allowed but you must dispose of toilet paper and / or personal hygiene products in the waste basket provided. A crew member will assist you with flushing the toilet. 

The yacht has a Bluetooth surround sound system for your enjoyment. A crew member will assist you in getting you connected. Once connected we will set the stereo at a safe volume. If the volume needs to be adjusted a crew member will assist you.

The front master bedroom and bathroom are off limits to the guests as we have the owner’s personal belongings in there along with necessary documentation for the coast guard. The door has a sign that reads crew only no entry. Please respect the privacy of the owner. 

We provide you with some ***ice and water*** for hydration. Please make sure you bring with you whatever you wish to eat and drink. Please make sure you bring cups and plates if you feel you will need them. 

We will have a nice cruise from the historic Miami River to the anchorage area. We will be at the anchorage area for approximately 2 hours. You will then have the option to jump in the water, enjoy our floating Lili pad, or rent Jet Skis. If you wish to rent Jet Skis please let the captain know and he can reserve them. 

If you have a balance remaining to be paid, the captain will collect it when your signing the coast guard documents on board the yacht. The balance must be paid in full before the yacht can leave the docks. 

The total amount that you have paid for your charter does not include any ***gratuity*** for the crew. If The Captain and First Mate do a great job ensuring your safety, comfort, & enjoyment. Please show your gratitude by tipping accordingly. Thank you!

When you arrive **PLEASE** contact the captain and he will greet you at the main marina entrance door.
